intended_object: One leaf (`.richLeaf rw5`) of a generated proof-certificate tree (`PTree`) for row 096 of the genus-four census of the Brill–Noether graphs development. The docstring and the module (`.../LowGenus/Generated/G4Row096.lean`) show this.
explanation: The definition only wraps the generated witness `rw5` as a leaf of the library's internal `PTree` certificate structure. According to its docstring, this leaf's entry inequalities sit at position 5 in `proof.subs`. It is auto-generated data used to check a case split in a computational proof. It is not a mathematical notion found in the literature, so Mathlib has no counterpart to compare it with.
